prompt:
A massive Tyrannosaurus Rex in the classic Jurassic Park upright pose, captured mid-roar with mouth OPEN wide showing teeth. This must be unmistakably a T-Rex from any angle.

PALETTE — strictly:
- Body, head, tail, legs: LEAVES (id 5, green) — the dominant ~65% of the build, this is dinosaur skin colour.
- Darker stripes along the back from neck down the spine to tail tip, plus highlights on the head ridges and brow: OAK_LOG (id 4, brown) — ~15%.
- Lighter belly and inner-thigh underside: SAND (id 6, pale yellow) — ~10%, only on the underside seen from below.
- Open mouth lined with teeth: SNOW (id 12, white) blocks for the TEETH, multiple visible — at least 6-8 teeth top + bottom in two rows. The mouth interior between rows should be BRICK (id 10, dark red) for the tongue/throat.
- Eyes: small STONE (id 3) dots with single GLASS (id 11) highlight in each.
- Sharp claws on hands and feet: STONE — pointed three-claw configuration.

POSE: Standing upright on hind legs, body leaning slightly forward in a powerful stance. Head RAISED and turned slightly to face the +Z direction (viewer's front). Jaws WIDE OPEN — the gap between upper and lower jaw should be 4-5 blocks tall so the teeth are clearly visible from the front. Tiny forearms (T-Rex's iconic short arms) held bent against the chest, with two visible claws each. Massive muscular hind legs supporting the body weight with three visible claws each. Long thick TAIL trailing behind for balance, gently arcing upward at the tip.

PROPORTIONS: ~30-35 blocks tall overall. Body torso ~10 blocks wide. Head large — about 8 blocks wide. THICK tail extending ~15 blocks behind the body for balance. The classic Jurassic Park silhouette: triangular head + powerful body + balancing tail behind.

The OPEN ROARING MOUTH with visible WHITE TEETH is the focal point and must be unmistakable from the front. Place teeth as individual SNOW blocks (one block each) along the upper and lower jaw lines. This is the iconic moment.

Use stepped blocks (lots of small cubes) for smooth curves on the body, tail, and head. No sharp polygonal edges.
